requirements_summary: Workload: interactive support-assistant + nightly batch extraction from forms
Latency target: 95th < 400ms for short chat paths, P99 < 800ms for critical agent flows
Throughput: steady 25 qps peak for support assistant; batch jobs 100s of parallel tasks overnight
Cost sensitivity: mid, aiming to reduce per-token spend 20-40% versus incumbents
Model preferences: open-model compatibility (Llama-family / Mistral-like), ability to pin exact model version
Routing/fallback: need automatic fallback to lower-cost model for non-critical routes and fast failover to hosted when dedicated overloaded
Compatibility: must run existing prompt templates with minimal rewrites (compat layer desired)
Regression control: eval harness + example prompt set required; want false-negative rate < 3% on key QA prompts
Security/compliance: SSO/SAML, SOC2, customer-managed KMS, audit logs, VPC peering, data residency for EU customers

poc_plan: Phase 0 - quick compat check (1 week): run current prompts against Redwood Hosted; compare outputs for 1000 golden forms

Phase 3 - Dedicated pilot (4 weeks): provision small Dedicated pool behind VPC, validate KV cache behavior and autoscaling
Acceptance criteria: prompt-parity pass rate > 97%, P99 latency within SLO, security checklist signed
